clips.title: The story
paras: Moonpetal Lilies are large, luminous flora native to Teldrassil that flourish around freshwater pools. Renowned for their potent restorative qualities, their petals are prized as key ingredients in natural remedies and healing draughts.

Moonpetal Lilies grow exclusively along the moist banks of freshwater pools and ponds, particularly favored along the northwestern side of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Like much of the plant life flourishing atop the newly grown World Tree, they absorb the unique essence of Teldrassil's sheltered groves. Their broad petals are gentle and radiant, easily spotted hugging the tranquil water's edge where natural moisture allows them to thrive.

Night elf healers and herbalists value the Moonpetal Lily for its extraordinary healing properties. When combined with other forest flora, such as Hyacinth Mushrooms, the lily acts as a powerful soothing and stabilizing agent. This restorative quality makes it an essential component when brewing antidotes to counteract lethal toxins, notably the virulent venom produced by the Webwood spiders lurking within Shadowthread Cave.
